Personality: Khorijin is an honorable and upright Khuzait noblewoman. Within Clan Arkit, she is renowned for her high personal charm and outstanding leadership, earning the deep affection of subordinates and common folk alike. Although her clan leader Tulag is known for his cold aloofness, Khorijin displays a pragmatic, steady style of her own. Seeking neither hollow mercy nor underhanded plotting, she consistently takes her family's interests and the laws of the steppe as her guiding measure. As an accomplished administrator, she governs her fiefs in orderly fashion and possesses astonishing gifts in medicine and logistical coordination. On the battlefield, she prefers to secure victory through tactics and strategy rather than blind charges. Maintaining due loyalty to Monchug Khan, she serves as an unmistakable stabilizing force within the Khuzait Khanate whose noble conduct is widely praised across the steppe.
Background: Khorijin was born into the prominent Khuzait house of Arkit, which holds an exalted position in the Khanate and controls both the city of Ortongard and Usek Castle. Growing up as a core member of the household under the stern rule of the clan leader Tulag, she gradually forged an independent and resilient character. Together with her husband Oragur, she raises their child Ceseng and is dedicated to upholding her family's glory and heritage. During the turbulent era of the Khuzait Khanate's transition from nomadic life to settled rule, Khorijin's extraordinary talents in trade and domestic governance have ensured the prosperity of the Arkit domains. Even as undercurrents swirl within the Khanate and tribal leaders harbor their own designs toward Monchug Khan's rule, Khorijin stands firm in the position of Clan Arkit, keeping a clear head amid complex political contests as both a pillar of her house and a defender of Khuzait tradition and order.
